newsitem.title: USA: Bausch & Lomb Inc in licensing agreement.
newsitem.headline: Bausch & Lomb Inc in licensing agreement.

text.p: Optical products maker Bausch & Lomb has obtained exclusive marketing rights in the United States and Canada for eye products based on iodine technology by Symbollon Corp, the companies said on Tuesday.

Under a new development and licensing agreement, Bausch & Lomb will make a series of payments to Symbollon which could amount to $5 million, plus royalties on product sales, the companies said in a statement.
Bausch & Lomb will also make an equity investment in Symbollon, purchasing up to $850,000 of Symbollon's common stock.
The agreement also provides Bausch & Lomb with options to extend its marketing rights to the rest of the world, and to include ear products, the companies said.
